title: MRI-to-CT Translation of Spinal Images via Anatomy-Guided Pseudo-Pairing and Adversarial Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.37134v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is routinely used to diagnose spinal disorders, but surgical planning often requires Computed Tomography (CT) for better visualization of vertebral bone anatomy. Synthesizing CT from MRI could avoid additional radiation exposure and streamline preoperative assessment.   We propose a three-stage framework for spine MRI-to-CT synthesis. First, an anatomy-guided vertebral matching system identifies similar sagittal MRI and CT slices using spine segmentations and aligns them through rigid registration, creating pseudo-paired data from unpaired scans. Second, these pairs train an adversarial diffusion model for MRI-to-CT translation. Third, synthesized slices are assembled into 3D volumes and refined by a network that improves inter-slice continuity and structural coherence.   The framework was trained on over 10,000 unpaired sagittal MRI and CT slices and evaluated on 1,911 slices from 83 MRI volumes spanni

translated_title: 基于解剖引导伪配对与对抗扩散的脊柱图像MRI到CT转换
translated_abstract: 磁共振成像（MRI）常规用于诊断脊柱疾病，但手术规划通常需要计算机断层扫描（CT）以更好地观察椎骨骨骼解剖结构。从MRI合成CT可以避免额外的辐射暴露并简化术前评估流程。我们提出一个用于脊柱MRI到CT合成的三阶段框架。首先，解剖引导的椎体匹配系统利用脊柱分割识别相似的矢状位MRI和CT切片，并通过刚性配准将其对齐，从未配对的扫描数据中创建伪配对数据。其次，使用这些配对数据训练一个用于MRI到CT转换的对抗扩散模型。第三，将合成的切片组装成3D体积，并通过一个网络进行细化，以改善切片间的连续性和结构一致性。该框架在超过10,000个未配对的矢状位MRI和CT切片上训练，并在来自83个MRI体积的1,911个切片上进行评估。
tldr: 提出了一种结合解剖引导伪配对和对抗扩散模型的三阶段框架，可从未配对的脊柱MRI图像合成CT图像，从而避免辐射暴露并优化术前评估。
en_tdlr: A three-stage framework combining anatomy-guided pseudo-pairing and adversarial diffusion models is proposed to synthesize CT images from unpaired spinal MRI scans, avoiding radiation exposure and streamlining preoperative assessment.
